notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, labeled FY2026 as in the Toyota record (the 20-F uses only 'fiscal year ended March 31, 2026'; matches data.js fy 'Mar 2026'). Source: Form 20-F filed June 18, 2026 (accession 0001193125-26-274893) on www.sec.gov; IFRS, figures in billions of yen (JPY), no FX conversion. SEC companyfacts has no facts for this year, so no xbrl objects are recorded. FINANCIAL SERVICES: Sony executed the Partial Spin-off of its Financial Services business (Sony Financial Group, SFGI) during the year; it is now a discontinued operation and was deconsolidated, and prior years are restated, so sales and geography are continuing operations only. The SFGI shares Sony distributed to its shareholders were a dividend in kind, not cash, and are not in the cash dividends figure (the 20-F says its dividend figures 'do not include dividends in kind of the shares of SFGI'). AKIO MORITA is deceased. The 20-F names no Morita family member, estate or foundation among major shareholders, so family is null. MAJOR SHAREHOLDERS: the 20-F lists Bulk Shareholding Reports above 5% filed with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau; percentages are as stated in each report (on the issued share capital at that time), asOf is each report date, and the reports do not say whether holdings are direct or beneficial. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' (¥135,028m). BUYBACKS: 'Payments for purchases of treasury stock' (¥522,089m); the 20-F says Sony completed ¥500.0 billion of repurchases from May 15, 2025 to March 24, 2026. STOCK COMP: ¥39,102m, which the 20-F says includes expenses of the Financial Services business.
